title: Vestibular pathways to cortices through the thalamus.jpg
author: Hitier M, Besnard S and Smith PF
caption: Central vestibular projections from the vestibular nuclei through the thalamus to multisensory cortical regions.
alt_text: Neuroanatomical pathway diagram tracing vestibular signals from inner ear to brainstem, thalamus, and cerebral cortex.
clinical_relevance: Central integration of vestibular, visual, and somatosensory signals underlies sensory conflict and nausea/vomiting in gravity-well entry motion sickness.
